about: Quiz Floor's questions (docs/plans/block-party-minigames.md, Quiz Floor): each with its 4 answers, in pad order (red, blue, yellow, green), and which one is right (0 to 3). The game shuffles the questions, not the answers. A starting list for the user to fill.

questions.question: Which mob explodes when it gets close?
What do you need to make a Nether portal?
What does a cow give you with a bucket?
Which block falls when nothing holds it up?
How many hearts does a player have?
What do you plant to grow wheat?
Which of these is a hostile mob in the Nether?
What light level stops most mobs spawning?
